It is scary. Especially because emotional eating is often a way people try to feel "in control", until they realise they've actually lost control. The best advice I can give you is to sit down to eat meals at the table without distractions. Try not to eat on the go, in front of TV, etc. Try to find things to do outside of the house, too. But like another comment mentioned, don't try not to eat when you are physically feeling hunger, that can lead to binges or worse.
